

== 2026 Retro World Championship result ==

Updated the lead and existing result row to place #4, preserving the published deck pair and the 23–25 October weekend date. The Players Committee catalog records Will Tarbox, Alex Prodoehl, Jeremy Christoffel and Zach Stenerson in that order.<ref name="retro-worlds-2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-12-swccg-retro-event-at-worlds-prem-ds2-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026/ 2026-12 SWCCG Retro Event at Worlds – Prem-DS2 Bloomington, Minnesota (Oct. 23-25, 2026)], [[Players Committee]] (2 November 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114003208/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-12-swccg-retro-event-at-worlds-prem-ds2-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026.html Internet Archive].</ref> Split an existing malformed row separator out of the 2000 World Championship Day 2 Light cell; retained the original result and deck text. Unrecorded finishes use blank cells rather than em dashes. Retained the earlier results and sources; source links used for further reading are under External links.
